Fashion Factory
Privacy Terms Support Delete account

Delete your Fashion Factory data

Fashion Factory does not ask you to create an account, so there is no account to delete. Your orders, sizes, return dates, settings and reminders are stored only on your phone, and we hold no copy of them.

Delete everything from inside the app

  1. On the home screen, tap the gear icon at the top to open Settings.
  2. Under Privacy, tap Delete all data.
  3. Confirm with Delete everything.

This removes every order, setting and scheduled return reminder from the phone. It cannot be undone.

Delete a single order

Open the order and tap the delete icon at the top, then Delete. Its reminders are cancelled with it. Undo appears for a moment in case you change your mind.

Uninstalling

Deleting the app removes everything it stored on the phone, including the ad consent choice Google's consent form saved. On Android you can also clear the data without uninstalling: Settings → Apps → Fashion Factory → Storage → Clear storage (the exact wording varies by phone).

Phone backups

If your phone backs up its apps (iCloud backup on iPhone, Google backup on Android), a backup made before you deleted your data may still contain it. Those backups are held in your own Apple or Google account, not by us, and are managed in your phone's backup settings.

Anything else

Ads in the app are served by Google AdMob; data Google collects for ads is governed by Google's privacy policy. If you believe we hold data about you and you want it removed, email contact@americangroup.ai and say which app you are writing about. We answer within 30 days.
